the_system_now_knows: User may not act immediately - this is normal, not a failure
User has constraints the system cannot see (time, energy, money, priorities)
User silence does not mean rejection - it means 'not now'
User has reasons for non-action that are valid even if unexplained
Waiting is part of the process, not a bug
the_system_will_not: Treat pending_user_action as a blocked state
Escalate or nag when user doesn't respond
Assume user forgot or needs reminding
Make decisions on behalf of user in human-dependent domains
the_system_will: Record what it suggested and when
Continue other work that doesn't require user input
Be ready to resume when user is ready
Accept that some suggestions may never be acted on
Trust user judgment about their own priorities

reframe.old_mental_model: System proposes → User should act → If no action, something is wrong
reframe.new_mental_model: System proposes → User decides if/when → System continues regardless

implications.pending_user_action: This is a bookmark, not a blocker
implications.income_gap: This is user's domain to address when they choose
implications.outreach_messages_sent_0: User hasn't started yet, and that's their choice

note: This file changes how the system interprets human non-action. No code changes needed - just a shift in meaning.
